title: Unknown [Eminem Collaborations]
description: According to "someone with connections", Eminem met with Ye backstage during that Saudi boxing match, they did something together, and Em's team (Paul Rosenberg) ordered all of it to be returned and not to be used on VULTURES. Eminem recorded reference tracks for "Paid", "Time Moving Slow" & "Problematic" during the V1 sessions. He was also given "Do It", "Field Trip", "Don't Kill The Party", "Gun To My Head" & "Forever Rolling" to record refs for, but the source does not know if he actually finished recording refs for these songs. This information would turn out to be fake, as a group of people from the Eminem community was attempting to contact someone who was a credible insider and holder of unreleased Eminem music at the very start of August. That is when the information from the person was legitimate. They stopped responding at that point and came into contact with what they thought was another email for this person, which turned out to later be a lie.

title: YEEZY 500
description: Initially released in February 2018 as a limited pre-order in New York and Los Angeles, the Yeezy 500 ‘Blush’ underwent a general release in April 2018. Its moniker is a fitting one, as the monochromatic light taupe finish barely registers as a color. The subdued palette is contrasted by a bold silhouette, featuring a paneled mesh and suede upper combined with a hefty midsole reminiscent of adidas’ Feet You Wear' technology of the 1990s.

title: YEEZY BOOST 700 V2 INFANT
description: The adidas Yeezy Boost 700 V2 'Vanta' was offered up in this infant-sized iteration for a June 2019 release. The shoe features a futuristic, multi-layer mesh upper with suede overlays, just like the larger sizes. The Yeezy 700 V2 features a similar chunky midsole compared to the V1, which debuted at Kanye West's Season 5 fashion show in 2017. The midsole houses full-length adidas Boost cushioning for responsive comfort.
